name: Object Insertion and Shadow Casting
aliases: Object Insertion and Shadow Casting in UrbanIR
definition: The method casts object shadows in the scene and scene shadows on the object, enhancing realism.
summary: Object Insertion and Shadow Casting is a hybrid rendering strategy that integrates virtual 3D objects into volume-rendered scenes by ensuring they cast and receive shadows, distinguished by its visibility-aware handling of objects entering existing shadows.
